Looking at the repository state, I can see the site has evolved nicely with a dynamic stats panel, recent updates list, and footer. The stats are updated via `app.js` but the "Cycle Progress" stat only shows a percentage number. A small, useful improvement would be adding a visual progress bar for the cycle progress, making it more intuitive at a glance.

This is a tiny, self-contained change touching `site/index.html`, `site/styles.css`, and `site/app.js` - all within the allowed `site/**` scope.

Exploration turn 2 of 2:
I'll add a visual progress bar to the Cycle Progress stat. This involves:
1. Adding a progress bar element in the cycle-progress stat in index.html
2. Adding CSS styles for the progress bar in styles.css
3. Updating app.js to set the progress bar width when updating the cycle progress value

This makes the cycle progress immediately understandable without reading the number, improving the site's usability in a small but real way.
